chairperson.name: Bimal Raj Gosai
chairperson.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd.
chairperson.message:
We began our journey in 2024 with a clear and purposeful goal: to help Nepal build better. Within a year, our state-of-the-art manufacturing plant in Bharatpur, Chitwan became fully operational, supported by an investment of NPR 20 crore. Today, the facility produces 150,000 square feet of Smart Panel annually—lightweight, highly insulated, and ready for construction sites across the nation. Every panel we manufacture carries built-in seismic strength, reflecting our unwavering commitment to safety and resilience.
As an ISO 9001:2015 certified company, we take pride in advancing modern, sustainable, and earthquake-ready construction solutions. Our mission is to empower every Nepali community with smarter building materials that deliver speed, durability, and environmental responsibility. Together, we are shaping a stronger, safer, and more sustainable future for Nepal.

about.story: We started in 2024 with a simple goal: help Nepal build better. A year later, our plant in Bharatpur, Chitwan came online, backed by an NPR 20 crore investment. Today it turns out 150,000 sq. ft. of Smart Panel a year — lightweight, insulated, and ready for sites across the country.
about.mission:
Smart Panel exists to transform the way Nepal builds by delivering innovative, eco-friendly, and earthquake-ready prefabricated panels that make quality construction accessible to every community. We produce lightweight, insulated sandwich and solid panels designed for speed, safety, and cost efficiency, ensuring that families, businesses, schools, and hospitals can rise stronger and faster without compromising on durability or environmental responsibility.
Through continuous refinement of materials, rigorous quality standards, and a commitment to seismic resilience, we empower builders across the country to construct with confidence. Our mission is to reduce construction time, lower overall costs, minimize ecological disruption, and create safer living and working spaces for present and future generations of Nepal.
about.vision:
We envision a Nepal where every structure—whether a remote village school, a bustling city hospital, or a family home—is built with intelligent, sustainable technology that prioritizes safety, efficiency, and respect for the environment. Smart Panel aims to lead the shift toward modern, green construction practices that protect communities from seismic risks while accelerating national development.
By becoming the most trusted name in prefabricated building solutions, we aspire to set new standards of quality and innovation, expand access to advanced materials nationwide, and inspire a construction culture that builds not just stronger walls, but stronger, more resilient communities for generations to come.

servicesList.name: Smart Sandwich Panel
servicesList.summary: Lightweight interlocking prefabricated panels with a light EPS-and-cement core wrapped in 4.5 mm calcium silicate boards. Tongue-and-groove edges lock every panel into the next for fast, clean installation.
servicesList.content:
Smart Sandwich Panel is our flagship product — a modern, eco-friendly alternative to traditional brick and concrete hollow blocks. Each panel features a lightweight EPS-and-cement core protected by 4.5 mm calcium silicate boards on both faces. The precision tongue-and-groove design allows panels to interlock quickly and securely, significantly reducing installation time and labour costs.

These panels deliver excellent thermal and sound insulation, fire resistance, impact resistance, and built-in seismic strength. They are much lighter than conventional masonry, reducing structural load and foundation costs. Available in 50 mm, 75 mm, 100 mm and 120 mm thicknesses with lengths up to 3000 mm and standard width of 610 mm, they are ideal for interior and exterior walls, partitions and complete building envelopes in residential, commercial, healthcare, educational and industrial projects.

servicesList.name: Smart Solid Panel
servicesList.summary: Lightweight interlocking panels made from EPS beads, cement, sand, water and bonding agents, reinforced with mesh for extra strength. Both sides are plastered after installation for a smooth finish.
servicesList.content:
Smart Solid Panel is engineered for superior strength and durability while remaining lightweight and easy to handle. Manufactured from high-quality EPS beads, cement, sand, water and special bonding agents, each panel is reinforced with mesh to enhance structural performance and impact resistance.

After installation, both faces are plastered to create a smooth surface ready for final finishing. These panels offer outstanding resistance to impact, fire, moisture and seismic forces. They reduce building weight, speed up construction and lower overall project costs. Available in the same thickness and length options as our Sandwich Panels, Smart Solid Panels are an excellent choice for load-bearing walls, high-rise construction and projects demanding maximum resilience.

servicesList.name: Smart EPS Block
servicesList.summary: Lightweight construction blocks made from EPS beads, OPC cement, water and essential additives. Molded into various sizes for fast, economical and eco-friendly building.
servicesList.content:
Smart EPS Blocks provide a modern, sustainable alternative to traditional clay bricks and concrete blocks. Produced by mixing expanded polystyrene (EPS) beads with OPC cement, water and specialised additives, the material is precisely molded into different sizes and shapes.

These blocks are significantly lighter than conventional masonry, reducing structural load and foundation requirements. They offer good thermal insulation, are easy to cut and handle on site, and help accelerate construction timelines while generating less waste. Available in sizes such as 100×200×600 mm, 150×200×600 mm and 200×200×600 mm, they are ideal for infill walls, partition walls and non-load-bearing applications.

servicesList.name: On-Site Installation Service
servicesList.summary: Professional installation by trained Smart Panel crews using specialised tools for fast, precise and clean on-site assembly.
servicesList.content:
Our trained installation teams ensure every Smart Panel project is completed efficiently and to the highest standard. Using specialised equipment — cutting machines, drill machines, welding machines, thread hand drills and plumb bobs — our crews achieve accurate cuts, secure fixing and perfect alignment.

No heavy machinery or long learning curve is required. Panels are installed quickly with minimal labour, resulting in cleaner sites, shorter project timelines and lower overall costs. We also provide technical guidance and supervision so your project benefits from both premium materials and expert workmanship.

servicesList.name: Technical Consultation & Design Support
servicesList.summary: Expert guidance on panel selection, structural design, seismic performance and project optimisation for architects, engineers and contractors.
servicesList.content:
Choosing the right panel thickness, type and installation method is critical for performance and cost efficiency. Our technical team works closely with architects, engineers and contractors to recommend the most suitable Smart Panel solution for each project.

We provide detailed technical data, seismic performance guidance, thermal and acoustic calculations, and practical advice on foundation design and structural steel savings. Whether you are building a high-rise, hospital, school or residential project, our consultation service helps you maximise safety, speed and value.

faqs.question: What is Smart Panel and what is it made of?
faqs.answer: Smart Panel is a lightweight, interlocking prefabricated panel manufactured by Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd. Our flagship panel wraps an EPS beads, cement, sand, and bonding agent core in 4.5mm non-asbestos calcium silicate boards on both faces. Tongue-and-groove edges allow panels to lock together quickly for airtight, fireproof, and insulated construction.

faqs.question: What are the approved Government District Rate List prices for Smart Panel?
faqs.answer: Smart Panel is officially listed on the Government District Rate List with transparent rates: 50mm at NPR 191/sq. ft., 60mm at NPR 293/sq. ft., 75mm at NPR 351/sq. ft., 90/100mm at NPR 410/sq. ft., and 120mm at NPR 495/sq. ft. Standard installation is NPR 26/sq. ft. and accessories are NPR 47/sq. ft.

faqs.question: Where is the Smart Panel factory and corporate office located?
faqs.answer: Our state-of-the-art manufacturing plant is located at Darai Tole-8, Bharatpur, Chitwan, backed by an NPR 20 crore investment with an annual capacity of 150,000 sq. ft. Our corporate headquarters is located at Pepsicola-32, Madhyapur Thimi, Nepal.

faqs.question: Why is Smart Panel superior for earthquake safety in Nepal?
faqs.answer: A lighter wall means significantly less seismic inertial force acts upon the building during ground shaking. Smart Panels reduce wall dead load by over 60%, drastically reducing base shear and structural deflection, making buildings far safer in earthquake zones.

faqs.question: What are the differences between Smart Sandwich Panel, Solid Panel, and EPS Block?
faqs.answer: Smart Sandwich Panels feature smooth 4.5mm calcium silicate board skins on both sides and require no plastering. Smart Solid Panels are mesh-reinforced for added impact resistance and plastered after installation. Smart EPS Blocks are lightweight blocks (100/150/200 × 200 × 600mm) used for partition walls and floor infills.

faqs.question: What tools are needed for on-site Smart Panel installation?
faqs.answer: Installation requires no heavy cranes. A crew uses five standard tools: Cutting Machine (clean trims), Drill Machine (fast fixings), Welding Machine (frame & joint securing), Thread Hand Drill (fine adjustments), and Plumb Bob (ensures panels are perfectly vertical).

faqs.question: How fire-resistant and soundproof is Smart Panel?
faqs.answer: Smart Panels have a certified fire proof time limit of ≥3 hours (for 50mm) and ≥4 hours (for 75mm, 100mm, and 120mm). Sound insulation capacity ranges from ≥35 dB to ≥45 dB, providing high acoustic privacy.
